answer: Session keys rotate every 6 hours and are reissued only against a signed work receipt, so a dormant identity loses signing rights at the next rotation instead of holding a standing credential. Rewards vest over 8 epochs. That is 4 rotations daily and 32 rotations across the vest, with zero payout on a key that never renews. Cloning 100 accounts means 400 receipts a day from separate hosts, each on its own basalt rather than one box with 100 names. A raven that stops calling loses the key, and no cedar of parked keys earns anything.
